solution.title: Windows Delivery Optimization — Bandwidth Savings & Peer Content Distribution (Intune)

products.name: Windows Delivery Optimization — Bandwidth Savings & Peer Content Distribution (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Stop every device downloading the same updates and apps over your internet link. Configure Windows Delivery Optimization in Intune so content crosses the WAN once per network — peer-shared and cached — then prove the savings. Self-guided, tested, for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Download once, share everywhere — cut the bandwidth your fleet wastes re-downloading the same bytes

Every managed Windows device pulls the same monthly updates, feature updates, Microsoft Store and Microsoft 365 Apps updates, Intune Win32 apps, and Autopilot / ESP content — independently, over your internet link. Across a fleet, and especially across branch offices on modest circuits, that is the traffic that saturates the WAN, slows provisioning, and inflates bandwidth cost. Delivery Optimization (DO) is the content-delivery engine built into Windows: devices share already-downloaded content with peers on the same network and pull from an on-network cache, so the same content crosses the internet once per network instead of once per device.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant to tune Delivery Optimization. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a novice admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that verify readiness and measure the savings. You implement with confidence, on your schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact Settings Catalog navigation in the right order: Download Mode, peer group scoping, bandwidth caps, and cache sizing. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill — and it pays for itself in reclaimed WAN bandwidth.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and pass/fail gates, so you prove peering works and measure the saving before you expand.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the peer + cloud/HTTP model, which content types DO optimizes, every Download Mode value, group scoping, bandwidth and cache controls, and Microsoft Connected Cache at decision level.
  • Requirements Guide — edition/version, the DO service, peer port 7680, endpoints, single-authority, and groups — each with how to verify and implement if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — build the DO Settings Catalog policy step by step (download mode, group, bandwidth, cache), assigned pilot → production, with US Government portal notes.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — readiness preflight, per-download source breakdown (peer/HTTP/cache bytes), fleet savings report, Intune policy export (Microsoft Graph), and guarded remediation.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next site and the next project.

The bottom line

The same updates and apps cross the internet once per network instead of once per device: lower WAN and internet bandwidth, faster branch provisioning, and hard peer-vs-HTTP-vs-cache numbers that prove the saving — deployable by a single administrator and validated before you expand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF + Word) — the complete, click-by-click solution: overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only by default; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DELOPT-Preflight.ps1 — verify Windows edition/version, the DO service (DoSvc), and peer port 7680
    • DELOPT-Get-Status.ps1 — per-download source breakdown: peer / HTTP / cache bytes
    • DELOPT-Report-Savings.ps1 — aggregate the bandwidth saving across a set of devices
    • DELOPT-Get-Policy.ps1 — export the Intune Delivery Optimization policy + assignments (Microsoft Graph; Global / USGov / USGovDoD)
    • DELOPT-Remediation.ps1 — guarded (-WhatIf) fixes for the common peering blockers

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
